content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Partnership for AI-Driven Drug Discovery Collaboration
agenda_items: Review of current AI model performance in target identification
Discussion of data sharing protocols and intellectual property (IP) agreements
Exploration of potential joint funding opportunities for next-generation algorithms
key_decisions: Agreed to prioritize development of a federated learning approach for sensitive pharmaceutical data, starting with a pilot project.
Approved submission of a joint grant application for advanced GPU clusters within the next month.
action_items: Dr. Lena Petrova to research and identify relevant national and international grant calls suitable for AI-driven drug discovery, due in two weeks.
Dr. Anya Sharma to draft initial data sharing agreement principles for review by legal counsel within one week.
All attendees to review preliminary KPI suggestions and provide feedback prior to the next meeting.
